must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the system complies with security standards and best practices.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in security assessments.
acceptance_criteria: All identified vulnerabilities are addressed promptly.
Security policies are documented and enforced.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system operates reliably with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: System uptime is monitored and reported.
Redundancy measures are implemented to prevent downtime.
Incident response plans are documented and tested.

should.title: System Performance
should.description: Ensure the system meets performance benchmarks post-migration.
should.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: System response times are consistently under 200ms.
Performance tests are conducted under peak load conditions.
Performance metrics are documented and reviewed regularly.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Scalability
should.description: Design the system to handle increased load without performance degradation.
should.metric: Support 2x current user base without performance loss.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm system can handle increased load.
should.verification: Scalability test with simulated load increase

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and accessible.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 in usability surveys.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback is collected and analyzed regularly.
Usability tests confirm ease of use.
Accessibility standards are met for all users.
should.verification: Usability testing with diverse user group

executive_summary: The project aims to modernize the MagicBox platform by migrating its PHP MVC framework to .NET 8 and React, focusing on preserving existing controller logic and enhancing system performance and security.
